record.field:
if not records and context.get('active_ids'): records = env['owner.move.stock'].browse(context['active_ids']) elif not records and context.get('active_id'): records = env['owner.move.stock'].browse(context['active_id'])
# 1. VALIDACIONES PREVIAS # --------------------------------------------------------------- for move in records: if move.state != 'available': raise UserError('Solo se puede validar un movimiento en estado Disponible.') if not move.detail_ids: raise UserError('El movimiento no tiene detalles escaneados.')
get_param = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param now = datetime.datetime.now() owner = move.owner_id picking_model = env['stock.picking'] move_line_model = env['stock.move.line']
# devuelve True si el campo existe en el modelo dado def _has_field(model, fname): return fname in model._fields
# busca un campo x_studio en el incoming move line y lo devuelve o False si no existe en ninguno de los dos lados def _copy_studio_field(incoming, fname): if incoming and _has_field(move_line_model, fname) and _has_field(incoming, fname): return incoming[fname] return False
# 2. CONFIGURACION DE LA SALIDA (OUT) # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2a. Operacion de picking type (outgoing) picking_type = False pt_param = sudo().get_param('owner_move_stock.exit_picking_type') if pt_param: try: picking_type = env['stock.picking.type'].browse(int(pt_param)) except (TypeError, ValueError): picking_type = False if not picking_type or not picking_type.exists(): picking_type = env['stock.picking.type'].search( [('code', '=', 'outgoing')], limit=1) if not picking_type: raise UserError('No hay una operacion de salida configurada.')
# 2b. Ubicacion de salida (origen del picking OUT) exit_location = False loc_param = sudo().get_param('owner_move_stock.exit_location') if loc_param: try: exit_location = env['stock.location'].browse(int(loc_param)) except (TypeError, ValueError): exit_location = False if not exit_location or not exit_location.exists(): exit_location = move._get_exit_location() if not exit_location: raise UserError('No hay una ubicacion de salida configurada.')
# 2c. Ubicacion destino del picking OUT (la del picking type o fallback a clientes) dest_location = picking_type.default_location_dest_id if not dest_location: dest_location = env.ref('stock.stock_location_customers')
# 3. CREAR Y VALIDAR PICKING DE SALIDA (OUT) # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3a. Valores base del picking OUT picking_vals = { 'partner_id': owner.id, 'picking_type_id': picking_type.id, 'location_id': exit_location.id, 'location_dest_id': dest_location.id, 'origin': move.name, 'scheduled_date': now, 'date_deadline': now, 'company_id': move.company_id.id, }
# 3b. Campos de Studio en el picking (solo si existen) for fname, value in { 'x_studio_control_agrupamiento': True, 'x_studio_inout_automatico': True, 'x_studio_factura_destinatario': move.origin_doc, 'x_studio_remito': move.exit_remito, 'x_studio_confirmar_peso': True, 'owner_id': owner.id, 'destino_id': move.dest_contact_id.id if move.dest_contact_id else False, }.items(): if _has_field(picking_model, fname): picking_vals[fname] = value
picking = picking_model.create(picking_vals)
# 3c. Helper para buscar la ultima move line entrante de un detalle (historico) def _get_incoming_line(detail): domain = [ ('picking_type_id.code', '=', 'incoming'), ('product_id', '=', detail.product_id.id), ('state', '=', 'done'), ] if detail.lot_id: domain.append(('lot_id', '=', detail.lot_id.id)) else: domain.append(('lot_id', '=', False)) return env['stock.move.line'].search( domain, order='date desc, id desc', limit=1)
# 3d. Crear moves con sus move lines para el picking OUT for line in move.line_ids: details = line.detail_ids if not details: continue
move_vals = { 'name': move.name, 'reference': move.name, 'picking_id': picking.id, 'product_id': line.product_id.id, 'product_uom_qty': sum(details.mapped('qty')), 'product_uom': line.product_id.uom_id.id, 'restrict_partner_id': owner.id, 'location_id': exit_location.id, 'location_dest_id': dest_location.id, 'company_id': move.company_id.id, 'picked': True, } new_move = env['stock.move'].create(move_vals)
# Crear move lines del OUT: una por cada detalle escaneado out_line_vals = [] for detail in details: incoming = _get_incoming_line(detail) quant = detail.quant_id
ml = { 'product_id': detail.product_id.id, 'product_uom_id': detail.product_id.uom_id.id, 'quantity': detail.qty, 'picking_id': picking.id, 'location_id': exit_location.id, 'location_dest_id': dest_location.id, 'lot_id': detail.lot_id.id if detail.lot_id else False, 'result_package_id': detail.package_id.id if detail.package_id else False, 'expiration_date': detail.expiration_date, 'company_id': move.company_id.id, }
# Si hay quant de origen, usar su paquete y propietario if quant: ml['quant_id'] = quant.id ml['package_id'] = quant.package_id.id if quant.package_id else False
# Copiar campos de Studio desde el move line historico for fname in [ 'x_studio_documento_original', 'x_studio_kilos', 'x_studio_nro_de_tropa', 'x_studio_p_transito', 'x_studio_n_produccion', ]: val = _copy_studio_field(incoming, fname) if val is not False: ml[fname] = val
out_line_vals.append((0, 0, ml))
if out_line_vals: new_move.write({'move_line_ids': out_line_vals})
# 3e. Validar el picking OUT res = picking.with_context(skip_immediate_transfer=True).button_validate() if isinstance(res, dict): picking._action_done()
# 4. CONFIGURACION DEL INGRESO (IN) # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
dest_supplier = move.dest_supplier_id if not dest_supplier: raise UserError('Debe indicar el Proveedor del destino.') dest_owner = move.dest_owner_id source_location = picking.location_dest_id if not source_location: raise UserError('No hay una ubicacion de origen para el ingreso.')
# 4a. Operacion de picking type (incoming) in_picking_type = False in_pt_param = sudo().get_param('owner_move_stock.entry_picking_type') if in_pt_param: try: in_picking_type = env['stock.picking.type'].browse(int(in_pt_param)) except (TypeError, ValueError): in_picking_type = False if not in_picking_type or not in_picking_type.exists(): in_picking_type = env['stock.picking.type'].search( [('code', '=', 'incoming')], limit=1) if not in_picking_type: raise UserError('No hay una operacion de entrada configurada.')
# 4b. Ubicacion destino del picking IN entry_location = False in_loc_param = sudo().get_param('owner_move_stock.entry_location') if in_loc_param: try: entry_location = env['stock.location'].browse(int(in_loc_param)) except (TypeError, ValueError): entry_location = False if not entry_location or not entry_location.exists(): entry_location = in_picking_type.default_location_dest_id if not entry_location: raise UserError('No hay una ubicacion de entrada configurada.')
# 5. CREAR Y VALIDAR PICKING DE INGRESO (IN) # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5a. Valores base del picking IN in_picking_vals = { 'partner_id': move.dest_supplier_id.id if move.dest_supplier_id else False, 'picking_type_id': in_picking_type.id, 'location_id': dest_location.id, # origen: donde quedo la mercaderia tras el OUT 'location_dest_id': entry_location.id, # destino: ubicacion de entrada final 'origin': move.name, 'scheduled_date': now, 'date_deadline': now, 'company_id': move.company_id.id, }
# 5b. Campos de Studio en el picking IN (solo si existen) for fname, value in { 'x_studio_inout_automatico': True, 'x_studio_control_agrupamiento': True, 'owner_id': move.dest_owner_id.id, }.items(): if _has_field(picking_model, fname): in_picking_vals[fname] = value
in_picking = picking_model.create(in_picking_vals)
# 5c. Crear moves con sus move lines para el picking IN. Se mapean los paquetes del OUT a nuevos paquetes en el IN new_pkg_by_pkg = {} moved_quant_ids = set()
for line in move.line_ids: details = line.detail_ids if not details: continue
in_line_vals = [] total_qty = 0.0
for detail in details: pkg_id = detail.package_id.id if detail.package_id else False
# Buscar el quant que quedo en la ubicacion de destino del OUT, despues de validar el picking de salida domain = [ ('location_id', '=', dest_location.id), ('owner_id', '=', owner.id), ('product_id', '=', detail.product_id.id), ('quantity', '>', 0), ('package_id', '=', pkg_id), ] if detail.lot_id: domain.append(('lot_id', '=', detail.lot_id.id)) else: domain.append(('lot_id', '=', False))
src_quant = env['stock.quant'].search(domain, limit=1) if not src_quant or src_quant.id in moved_quant_ids: continue moved_quant_ids.add(src_quant.id)
# Crear nuevo paquete para el IN si el detalle tenia paquete new_pkg = new_pkg_by_pkg.get(pkg_id) if pkg_id and not new_pkg: new_pkg = env['stock.quant.package'].create({}) new_pkg_by_pkg[pkg_id] = new_pkg
incoming = _get_incoming_line(detail)
ml = { 'product_id': detail.product_id.id, 'product_uom_id': detail.product_id.uom_id.id, 'quantity': src_quant.quantity, 'picking_id': in_picking.id, 'location_id': dest_location.id, 'location_dest_id': entry_location.id, 'lot_id': src_quant.lot_id.id if src_quant.lot_id else False, 'package_id': src_quant.package_id.id if src_quant.package_id else False, 'result_package_id': new_pkg.id if new_pkg else False, 'owner_id': src_quant.owner_id.id if src_quant.owner_id else owner.id, 'quant_id': src_quant.id, 'company_id': move.company_id.id, }
if detail.expiration_date: ml['expiration_date'] = detail.expiration_date elif src_quant.lot_id and src_quant.lot_id.expiration_date: ml['expiration_date'] = src_quant.lot_id.expiration_date
# Copiar campos de Studio desde el move line historico for fname in [ 'x_studio_documento_original', 'x_studio_kilos', 'x_studio_nro_de_tropa', 'x_studio_p_transito', 'x_studio_n_produccion', ]: val = _copy_studio_field(incoming, fname) if val is not False: ml[fname] = val
in_line_vals.append((0, 0, ml)) total_qty += src_quant.quantity
if not in_line_vals: continue
env['stock.move'].create({ 'name': move.name, 'reference': move.name, 'picking_id': in_picking.id, 'product_id': line.product_id.id, 'product_uom_qty': total_qty, 'product_uom': line.product_id.uom_id.id, 'restrict_partner_id': owner.id, 'location_id': dest_location.id, 'location_dest_id': entry_location.id, 'company_id': move.company_id.id, 'picked': True, 'move_line_ids': in_line_vals, })

# 6a. Transferir la propiedad de los quants al propietario destino for detail in move.detail_ids: pkg_id = detail.package_id.id if detail.package_id else False new_pkg = new_pkg_by_pkg.get(pkg_id)
entry_domain = [ ('location_id', '=', entry_location.id), ('product_id', '=', detail.product_id.id), ('owner_id', '=', owner.id), ('quantity', '>', 0), ('package_id', '=', new_pkg.id if new_pkg else False), ] if detail.lot_id: entry_domain.append(('lot_id', '=', detail.lot_id.id)) else: entry_domain.append(('lot_id', '=', False))
entry_quant = env['stock.quant'].search(entry_domain, limit=1) if entry_quant: entry_quant.write({'owner_id': move.dest_owner_id.id}) detail.write({'quant_id': entry_quant.id})
